user.title: Lage Monitor
user.description: Aggregate official warning and news sources into a Home Assistant situation overview.

data.warn_mowas: Include civil protection alerts (MOWAS, BIWAPP, KATWARN)
data.include_news: Include major German news RSS feeds
data.layer_water: Water levels (flood marks) on the map
data.layer_radiation: Elevated radiation readings (BfS) on the map
data.alert_score_drop: Event when the score drops by at least … points
data.alert_route_delay: Event for delays on my routes from … minutes

data_description.autobahn_roads: Comma separated, e.g. A8, A81 (max 8). Empty = off. Webcams are still images.
data_description.layer_water: Shows gauges in the local radius at flood mark 1 or higher (PEGELONLINE).
data_description.layer_radiation: Shows stations with dose rate of 0.3 uSv/h or more (BfS ODL).
data_description.live_streams: One entry per line: Name | URL or camera.entity | optional region. Supports YouTube links, .m3u8, image URLs and camera.* entities.
data_description.alert_notify_service: Optional, e.g. notify.mobile_app_my_phone. The lage_monitor_alert event is always fired.
data_description.alert_score_drop: 0 = off. Compared with the previous refresh.
data_description.alert_cooldown_min: Identical events are not reported again within this time.
data_description.autobahn_routes: One line per route, e.g. A81 | Feuerbach, Ludwigsburg. Keywords are exits or places from the reports; without keywords the whole autobahn counts. Reports and webcams on your routes are shown even outside the radius.
data_description.water_always: Shows the nearest gauges in the radius with water level and trend, even below flood mark 1. Only applies when water levels are enabled.
data_description.alert_route_delay: 0 = off. Reports new traffic jams on your routes from this delay on.

init.title: Options
init.description: Choose which sources and filters Lage Monitor should use.

data.warn_mowas: Include civil protection alerts (MOWAS, BIWAPP, KATWARN)
data.include_news: Include major German news RSS feeds

data_description.nina_ars: No longer needed for warnung.bund.de and can be left empty.
data_description.warn_area: City, town, or district name as listed on warnung.bund.de, for example Stuttgart, Leonberg, or Landkreis Ludwigsburg.
data_description.news_limit: How many headlines can contribute to the situation scoring and map.
data_description.police_count_mode: Choose between all police items and only locally relevant entries.
data_description.focus_mode: Germany-wide uses all sources, local mode filters more strongly by keywords and radius.
data_description.local_keywords: Comma-separated places or regions, for example Stuttgart, Leonberg, Weilimdorf.
data_description.alert_radius_km: Radius used for local relevance around the Home position.
data_description.warn_mowas: Enable or disable the civil protection channels from warnung.bund.de.
data_description.warn_dwd: Enable or disable weather alerts from the German Weather Service.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the sources are refreshed.

test_alert.name: Send test alert
test_alert.description: Fires the lage_monitor_alert event with type test and forwards it to the configured notify service. Use it to check automations and push notifications.
